item.text: The startup path returns early for non-database storage only when authentication is disabled. That makes JWT-only auth open a database, and it also skips JWT middleware setup if the early return is broadened. I’ll keep middleware setup on the common path and choose the auth store based on enabled methods.

package config

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
)

func TestAuthenticationDatabaseRequirements(t *testing.T) {
	cleanup := &AuthenticationCleanupSchedule{Interval: time.Hour, GracePeriod: time.Minute}
	config := AuthenticationConfig{Required: true}

	assert.False(t, config.RequiresDatabase())
	assert.False(t, config.ShouldRunCleanup())

	for _, method := range config.Methods.AllMethods() {
		t.Run(method.Name(), func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg := AuthenticationConfig{Required: true}
			for _, candidate := range cfg.Methods.AllMethods() {
				if candidate.Method == method.Method {
					candidate.Enable(t)
					candidate.SetCleanup(t, *cleanup)
				}
			}
			wantDatabase := method.Method != auth.Method_METHOD_JWT
			assert.Equal(t, wantDatabase, method.RequiresDatabase)
			assert.Equal(t, wantDatabase, cfg.RequiresDatabase())
			assert.Equal(t, wantDatabase, cfg.ShouldRunCleanup())
		})
	}

	config.Methods.JWT.Enabled = true
	config.Methods.JWT.Cleanup = cleanup
	config.Methods.Token.Enabled = true
	assert.True(t, config.RequiresDatabase())
	assert.False(t, config.ShouldRunCleanup())
	config.Methods.Token.Cleanup = cleanup
	assert.True(t, config.ShouldRunCleanup())
	config.Methods.Token.Enabled = false
	assert.False(t, config.RequiresDatabase())
	assert.False(t, config.ShouldRunCleanup())
}

func TestAuthenticationGRPCJWTWithoutDatabase(t *testing.T) {
	key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)

	publicKey, err := x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(&key.PublicKey)

			cfg.Authentication.Methods.JWT.Cleanup = &config.AuthenticationCleanupSchedule{}

			register, interceptors, shutdown, err := authenticationGRPC(context.Background(), zaptest.NewLogger(t), cfg, false, false)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Len(t, register, 2)
			require.Len(t, interceptors, 3)
			require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
